strict_temporal_policy.actual_gpx: eligible subject to GPX road-match quality
strict_temporal_policy.reconstructed_high: candidate class only until road-network map matching passes >=80% matched anchors and <=25m median match distance
strict_temporal_policy.reconstructed_partial: not globally eligible for Road x 10 min; only separately validated subsegments may later qualify
strict_temporal_policy.spatial_only: not eligible for Road x 10 min temporal negatives

important_note: The 21 high-reconstruction nights are not counted as strict Road x 10 min usable merely because they are classified HIGH. PR #19 added an explicit map-match gate.
